note: pgfplotstable, which the README lists as bundled: a table read into a plot, and the same table typeset in a node beside it. Until 0.2.0 only pgfplotstable.sty was bundled, and it inputs pgfplotstable.code.tex, which was not: on 0.1.5 the diagram never finished, and on 0.2.0's engine before the file was added it stopped with "I can't find file `pgfplotstable.code.tex'".
